function:
do_urlmount() {
    rc=1
    modprobe "${MP_QUIET}" isofs

    [ "$quiet" != "y" ] && log_begin_msg "Trying to download and mount ${URL}"

    target=$(basename "${URL}")

    if wget "${URL}" -O "${target}"; then
        if mount -o ro "${target}" "${mountpoint}"; then
            if is_casper_path $mountpoint && matches_uuid $mountpoint; then
                rc=0
            else
                umount $mountpoint
            fi
        fi
    fi

    return ${rc}
}
